Not your trip: This trip is not assigned to you.
Stop not found: Stop not found on this trip.
Not an offer: This trip is no longer available as an offer.
Cannot accept: Trip can no longer be accepted.
Cannot decline: Trip can no longer be declined.
Cannot start: Trip cannot be started in its current state.
Cannot complete: Trip cannot be completed in its current state.
Already busy: You already have an active trip.
Trip not started: Start the trip before performing stop actions.
Wrong stop: You must arrive at the next stop in order.
Stop already arrived: You have already arrived at this stop.
Mark arrived first: Mark arrival before confirming the stop.
Not a pickup stop: This stop is not a pickup stop.
Not a dropoff stop: This stop is not a dropoff stop.
Resolve all passengers: Every passenger at this stop must be resolved (picked up, dropped off, or no-show).
Resolve all packages: Every package at this stop must be resolved (collected, delivered, or marked failed).
Conflicting passenger state: A passenger cannot be both picked up and a no-show.
Conflicting package state: A package cannot be both collected and not-found.
Stops outstanding: All stops must be confirmed before completing the trip.
Cannot cancel: Trip cannot be cancelled in its current state.
Cancellation blocked mid-trip: You cannot cancel after picking up a passenger. Please contact support.
